items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: I’m talking about the Sonny Rollins of the 1960s maybe that really got to me.

ctx.x: Yeah. He has such a way of interpreting songs and finding the —

Well it’s the old Sonny Rollins. I’m talking about the Sonny Rollins of the 1960s maybe that really got to me. The newer stuff I haven’t paid much attention to. But the way he handled pop songs, like you said, that really got to me. I loved it. That was a mind at work that I really was interested in there.
Showing up in New York, is it mostly like word of mouth, meeting the right people?
